eyebrow: T-SQL for Database Administrators · Chapter One
subtitle: Lesson 2 · SQL Server Internals Through T-SQL

code:
SELECT name, database_id, state_desc,
       recovery_model_desc, collation_name
FROM sys.databases
ORDER BY name;
caption: sys.databases — every database on the instance, from any database context.

code:
SELECT t.name AS table_name,
       c.name AS column_name,
       ty.name AS data_type,
       c.max_length, c.is_nullable
FROM sys.tables AS t
JOIN sys.columns AS c ON c.object_id = t.object_id
JOIN sys.types  AS ty ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE t.name = 'Employee';
caption: sys.tables joined to sys.columns on object_id.
